title: feat(openwebui): pin everyday models and explain Pollen billing
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16242

## What changes for users

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Default / pins | `openai` (an alias, not an id in the model list); nothing pinned | New chats open on `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`; four everyday models that need no paid balance are pinned for users with no pins |
| Empty-chat suggestions | Upstream set: options trading, kids' art | Four that work with any model |
| Paying with your own Pollen | Not mentioned | Dismissible banner: chats are paid from your Pollen, link to Enter |
| Share to openwebui.com / arena | On | Off (the share button uploads chats to a third party) |
| Rest of the picker | Gen's catalog order | Unchanged |

Login, the per-user `system_oauth` key, the MCP tool server and existing chats are untouched.

The values live in `apps/openwebui/ui-defaults.js`. `worker.js` seeds them as env vars. `scripts/apply-ui-defaults.mjs` applies the same values to a database that has already booted.

## Existing installations

Open WebUI reads these env vars only while the setting is missing from its config table, so a deploy alone changes nothing on production. Checked locally on Open WebUI 0.11.3 (the pinned image), against a database created with the old values:

1. Restarted it with the new env: default model, pins, suggestions, banner and both switches stayed the same.
2. `OWUI_URL=... OWUI_TOKEN=<admin key> node scripts/apply-ui-defaults.mjs`: all of them changed, no restart. `DEFAULT_MODEL_METADATA` (`builtin_tools: false`) survived, because the script reads each form and changes only its own fields; a bare `POST /configs/models` would reset it.

A user's own pins win: the frontend uses `default_pinned_models` only while `settings.pinnedModels` is undefined, and drops ids that are not in the list.
